hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.json) node -e "JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(process.argv[1],\"utf8\"))" "$f" 2>/dev/null || { echo "JSON parse failed: $f" >&2; exit 2; };; esac

cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); printf "%s" "$cmd" | grep -Eq "(^|[^[:alnum:]_.-])git([[:space:]]+-c[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)" || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { git diff --check && git diff --cached --check; } >&2 || { echo "git diff --check failed; fix whitespace errors before committing" >&2; exit 2; }
